title: HausmanHub managed-switch migration re-arm request v1
description: Local-admin explicit compare-and-set request that supersedes a durable managed-switch migration receipt so the next startup re-evaluates the recomputed protected-topology manifest. It carries no private ids and sends no physical command.

expectedReceiptRevision.description: Compare-and-set receipt revision. A stale value must fail without superseding the durable receipt.

confirm.description: Explicit owner/local-admin confirmation that the completed or prepared migration receipt must not be accepted automatically.
